[Council File 26-1612; CD 11]
Motion (Park, McOsker – Harris-Dawson) relative to implementation of Proposition TE, which proposes a one-time exemption from the City's special documentary transfer tax established under Measure ULA, for qualifying properties impacted by the January 2025 wildfires.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
